client_updater_fix.root_cause: The installed 0.3.0+3 client's updater looked for the signature asset 'oip-macos-manifest.sig', which the release never publishes (it publishes 'oip-macos-manifest.json.sig'), so the offer failed silently.
client_updater_fix.fix_summary: Decision logic extracted into OIPGitHubOTA.swift (manifestAssetName/signatureAssetName/archiveAssetName constants, safe URL, build compare, verify()); the live updater now uses the shared OIPGitHubOTA.* types, logs every reject reason, and the installer helper got an OIP_OTA_APP_NAME test seam.
client_updater_fix.native_macos_release_build: PASS: flutter build macos --release succeeds; 254 OIPGitHubOTA symbols compiled into the universal (x86_64+arm64) oip_dashboard binary (sha256 f84b61f009a324bd3275a0d73352c12a15773229ca71b4392d1ed111ba853760), up from 251 after the archive-digest helper below was added.
client_updater_fix.archive_digest_coverage: ADDED (revision 2665891): acceptance requires rejecting invalid archive digests with automated test coverage. The digest check previously existed only inline in the live downloader (MainFlutterWindow.swift) and the archiveDigestMismatch enum case was dead code, so no test covered it. Extracted pure OIPGitHubOTA helpers sha256Hex(of:) and verifyArchiveDigest(sha256Hex:manifest:); the live downloader now calls them, so the network path and the unit test share one implementation. tests/oip_ota_logic.py now proves the matching digest is accepted and a tampered digest returns .archiveDigestMismatch(got, expected).
client_updater_fix.regression_tests: PASS: tests/oip_ota_logic.py (2, decision logic incl. the new archive-digest matching/mismatch cases + asset-name agreement), tests/oip_ota_install_helper.py (4, refuse-without-touching on exit 21/22/23 and byte-for-byte rollback on forced post-swap launch failure), tests/oip_github_ota_package.py (1, direct/Store isolation). 7 OTA tests total, all green.
